faucons.name: The Black Falcons
faucons.description: Organized pirates. Military discipline. Alanossa at their head. Joining means choosing the shadow side.
faucons.bonus: Access to pirate zones without combat · +20% credits on loot · Discounted weapons

emporium.name: The Emporium
emporium.description: An alliance of merchants. Currency is their law. Legal on the surface. Everything else is negotiable.
emporium.bonus: -15% on all purchases · Exclusive prices · Extended trade network

gardiens.name: The Scarlet Guardians
gardiens.description: An order of warrior-paladins. Draconian justice. No nuance, no mercy.
gardiens.bonus: +50% rep on heroic acts · Access to military zones · Elite equipment

culte.name: The Cult of the Void
culte.description: Mystics of deep space. Their rituals work — no one knows why.
culte.bonus: Amplified WTF events · Access to artifacts · Visions of the future (free info)
